items.title: How a US extradition bid over Hamas allegations put a wealthy activist before a Spanish court

sentences.en: How a US extradition bid over Hamas allegations put a wealthy activist before a Spanish court.
sentences.zh: 美国因哈马斯指控提出引渡请求，导致一位富豪活动家在西班牙法院受审。

sentences.en: James ‘Fergie’ Chambers, a Cox Enterprises heir, faced a two-hour hearing about alleged support for Hamas A two-hour hearing in Spain’s high court Friday on the US extradition request of wealthy leftwing activist and philanthropist James “Fergie” Chambers turned out to be a study in contrasts.
sentences.zh: Cox Enterprises继承人詹姆斯·“弗吉”·钱伯斯因涉嫌支持哈马斯而接受了长达两小时的听证会。周五，西班牙高等法院就美国要求引渡富有的左翼活动家和慈善家詹姆斯·“弗吉”·钱伯斯一事举行了长达两小时的听证会，结果成为了一场对比鲜明的案例研究。

sentences.en: Chambers’s defense took most of the session to query the US citizen and detail irregularities in the Trump administration’s extradition request – several of which the Guardian has reported on – as well as the figures of Spanish law that would lead the three-judge panel to deny the request; while the prosecutor sped through his case, head down, asking Chambers no questions at all.
sentences.zh: 钱伯斯的辩护律师在庭审中花了大部分时间质询这位美国公民，并详细列举了特朗普政府引渡请求中的不合规之处——其中一些《卫报》曾有报道——以及西班牙法律中可能导致三名法官组成的合议庭驳回该请求的条款；而检察官则低着头匆匆陈述了自己的案情，根本没有向钱伯斯提问。

items.title: Choking fires, deadly heat and devastating floods: 2026 in extreme weather

sentences.en: Choking fires, deadly heat and devastating floods: 2026 in extreme weather.
sentences.zh: 窒息性火灾、致命高温和毁灭性洪灾：2026年的极端天气。

sentences.en: People around the world have contended with unprecedented weather events and their fatal effects caused by the climate catastrophe After the world’s hottest summer since records began in 1850, the death toll from extreme weather in 2026 is already in the high tens of thousands.
sentences.zh: 自1850年有记录以来，全球经历了有史以来最炎热的夏季，2026年极端天气造成的死亡人数已达数万人，世界各地的人们正在应对前所未有的天气事件及其由气候灾难引发的致命影响。

sentences.en: That is a conservative estimate and is certain to rise much higher.
sentences.zh: 这是一个保守的估计，肯定会大大提高。

sentences.en: As Cop31 continues and scientists warn that climate breakdown may be accelerating , the Guardian looks back at a year of droughts, fires and floods as a reminder that, unless the world takes urgent action to cut emissions, this disastrous year will be one of the best of the rest of our lives.
sentences.zh: 随着第31届联合国气候变化大会（COP31）的持续召开，科学家们警告称，气候崩溃可能正在加速。英国《卫报》回顾了这一年发生的干旱、火灾和洪灾，以此提醒人们，除非全球采取紧急行动来减少排放，否则这一灾难性的一年将是我们余生中最好的一年。

items.title: Kitesurf is now open source

sentences.en: Kitesurf is now open source.
sentences.zh: Kitesurf 现在是开源的。

sentences.en: We introduced Kitesurf , our stateless browser for AI agents that runs entirely on top of Workers, in August and followed up in September with WebMCP support, new APIs, and improved compatibility.
sentences.zh: 我们在8月份推出了Kitesurf，这是我们面向AI代理的无状态浏览器，完全在Workers之上运行。9月份，我们又推出了WebMCP支持、新API和改进的兼容性。

sentences.en: On every occasion, we mentioned our commitment to open sourcing it so that developers could run their own browser engine on their own Cloudflare accounts if they want to.
sentences.zh: 在每次场合，我们都提到我们致力于将其开源，以便开发者如果愿意，可以在自己的 Cloudflare 账户上运行自己的浏览器引擎。

sentences.en: That promise is now real.
sentences.zh: 这个承诺现在已经兑现。

sentences.en: Kitesurf is open source on GitHub under the Apache 2.0 license.
sentences.zh: Kitesurf 是 GitHub 上的开源项目，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。

sentences.en: You can read the code, run it locally, change it, and deploy your own instance to Cloudflare Workers.
sentences.zh: 您可以阅读代码、在本地运行代码、更改代码，并将您自己的实例部署到 Cloudflare Workers。

sentences.en: A browser built for agents Kitesurf runs entirely on Cloudflare Workers.
sentences.zh: 专为代理打造的浏览器Kitesurf完全在Cloudflare Workers上运行。

sentences.en: It parses HTML, applies CSS, executes page JavaScript, and renders screenshots without a browser container.
sentences.zh: 它会解析 HTML、应用 CSS、执行页面 JavaScript，并在没有浏览器容器的情况下渲染屏幕截图。

sentences.en: It supports the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), so you can connect clients such as Puppeteer.
sentences.zh: 它支持 Chrome 开发工具协议 (CDP)，因此您可以连接 Puppeteer 等客户端。

sentences.en: Our main goal is to give AI agents a lightweight, efficient browser — one that can load websites, execute JavaScript, and interact with pages while using less CPU and memory than a full browser like Chromium, and scaling on demand across Cloudflare’s global Workers network.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要目标是为 AI 代理提供一款轻量级、高效的浏览器——这款浏览器能够加载网站、执行 JavaScript 并与网页进行交互，同时与 Chromium 等全功能浏览器相比，它使用的 CPU 和内存更少，并且能够根据需求在 Cloudflare 的全球 Workers 网络上进行扩展。

sentences.en: Read more about why and how we built Kitesurf in our initial announcement and how to use it in Browser Run’s developer documentation.
sentences.zh: 请参阅我们的首发公告，进一步了解我们为何以及如何打造 Kitesurf，并参阅 Browser Run 的开发者文档，了解如何使用 Kitesurf。

items.title: Adapting to AI penetration testing orchestrators: The Modern Security Model

sentences.en: Adapting to AI penetration testing orchestrators: The Modern Security Model.
sentences.zh: 适应人工智能渗透测试编排工具：现代安全模型。

sentences.en: Over the last month, the number of Large Language Model (LLM) penetration testing and orchestration frameworks has exploded.
sentences.zh: 在过去一个月里，大型语言模型（LLM）渗透测试和编排框架的数量激增。

sentences.en: Just a few weeks ago, ARTEX — an open source agentic penetration testing system that automates offensive security workflows — was the only framework available.
sentences.zh: 就在几周前，ARTEX（一种开源的代理式渗透测试系统，可自动化进攻性安全工作流程）还是唯一可用的框架。

sentences.en: In just the last three days, we have seen over 50 framework families attempt to scan Cloudflare customers globally.
sentences.zh: 仅在过去三天内，我们就目睹了超过 50 个框架家族试图扫描全球范围内的 Cloudflare 客户。

sentences.en: The number of Internet Protocol (IP) addresses seen running these frameworks has grown into the thousands and continues to increase daily.
sentences.zh: 运行这些框架的互联网协议 (IP) 地址数量已增至数千个，并且每天都在持续增加。

sentences.en: The proliferation of these frameworks has significantly changed the status quo in cyber defense: defenders are struggling to keep up with the volumetric nature of these autonomously guided attacks.
sentences.zh: 这些框架的扩散显著改变了网络防御的现状：防御者正竭力跟上这些自主引导攻击的规模性。

sentences.en: ARTEX was taken down by its creator Autumn-27 on October 8.
sentences.zh: ARTEX 于 10 月 8 日被其创作者 Autumn-27 下架。

sentences.en: (“The malicious exploitation of this tool runs entirely counter to its original intent,” they wrote in Chinese.
sentences.zh: “恶意利用该工具完全背离了其初衷。”他们用中文写道。

sentences.en: ) But in the month since, the ecosystem has exploded with new fragmented versions of it.
sentences.zh: ）但在此后的一个月里，该生态系统涌现出了大量新的碎片化版本。

sentences.en: There are now over 12,000 repositories, with several hundred unique forks containing lineage from the original repository.
sentences.zh: 目前有超过 12000 个代码仓库，其中有数百个独特的派生版本包含源自原始代码仓库的沿袭。

sentences.en: Additionally, hundreds of other similar agentic orchestration frameworks have been created since October 8.
sentences.zh: 此外，自 10 月 8 日以来，又涌现了数百个其他类似的代理编排框架。

sentences.en: Daily requests of AI penetration testing (pentesting) and exploitation tools has grown by 30x since October 1.
sentences.zh: 自10月1日以来，对人工智能渗透测试（渗透测试）和漏洞利用工具的每日请求量增长了30倍。

items.title: Connect Google Wallet to Gemini for personal finance insights

sentences.en: Connect Google Wallet to Gemini for personal finance insights.
sentences.zh: 将Google钱包关联到Gemini，以获取个人财务洞察。

sentences.en: All Gemini app users in the U.S. can connect Google Wallet to get responses informed by their spending habits.
sentences.zh: 美国的所有 Gemini 应用用户都可以关联 Google 钱包，以获得基于其消费习惯的回复。
